<script>
(function () {
  var rows = [
    [4,10],[3,11],[2,11],[2,12],[1,12],[1,13],[0,13],[0,12],
    [1,10],[2,9],[2,10],[2,10],[3,9],[3,8],[4,8],[5,7]
  ];
  var spacing = 12, r = 4, offsetX = 4, offsetY = 4;
  var svg = document.getElementById('africa-dots');
  var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  rows.forEach(function (range, rowIdx) {
    for (var col = range[0]; col <= range[1]; col++) {
      var c = document.createElementNS(ns, 'circle');
      c.setAttribute('cx', offsetX + col * spacing);
      c.setAttribute('cy', offsetY + rowIdx * spacing);
      c.setAttribute('r', r);
      svg.appendChild(c);
    }
  });
  [[12,11],[12,12],[12,13]].forEach(function (p) {
    var c = document.createElementNS(ns, 'circle');
    c.setAttribute('cx', offsetX + p[0] * spacing);
    c.setAttribute('cy', offsetY + p[1] * spacing);
    c.setAttribute('r', r * 0.8);
    c.setAttribute('class', 'madagascar-dot');
    svg.appendChild(c);
  });
})();

(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('country-search');
  var tiles = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#country-grid [data-name]'));
  var noResults = document.getElementById('no-results');
  input.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    var q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    var visibleCount = 0;
    tiles.forEach(function (el) {
      var match = el.getAttribute('data-name').indexOf(q) !== -1;
      el.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
      if (match) visibleCount++;
    });
    noResults.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? '' : 'none';
  });
})();
</script>
